Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Sara Duterte’s gun ownership presented at impeachment court, but senators unimpressed

blocks.text: The prosecution establishes Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Mans Carpio own 51 guns.

items: Baste Duterte asks impeachment court to reset trial appearance

blocks.text: Davao City mayor Baste Duterte asks the Senate impeachment court to reset the date of his testimony in the trial of his older sister, Vice President Sara Duterte.

items: Does Taguig have ghost flood control projects? The conflicting claims of Dizon and Lacson

blocks.text: Senator Ping Lacson says his team identified at least 32 allegedly anomalous flood control projects in Taguig City, with at least two being ghost projects.

items: Fuel prices finally roll back on September 29 after weeks of hikes

blocks.text: Fuel prices will go down starting Tuesday, September 29, after three consecutive weeks of steep increases.

items: Alex Eala opens quest for Asian Games gold, Olympic berth with dominant win

blocks.text: Filipina tennis ace Alex Eala begins her Asian Games campaign with a strong win against Thailand’s Patcharin Cheapchandej, 6-1, 6-0. – Rappler.com
